attempt: Require a non-null live Ref from native Store.addEntity to conclude that a decorative attachment has been saved and that its support is occupied.
reason_failed: Hytale 0.7.2 can move the new entity into the saved holders of a loaded non-ticking EntitySection during addEntity. The returned reference is null although the item-backed entity is persisted. A live-entity-only occupancy scan misses it.
environment: Hytale 0.7.2 d769dc3d57881261a62858e1394f0e4de9a21eca, Java 25, Windows, headless isolated world with no player activating sections.
error_signature: First probes: Occupied surface not detected / null Ref following addEntity; final native section activation and reopen tests pass.
conditions: Native non-ticking section parks an entity during addEntity
Decorations persist support ownership independently of their transient live Ref
workaround: Scan both live attachment components and nearby loaded EntitySection saved holders. Do not refund on a null Ref alone. In a headless live-entity fixture activate the native entity sections explicitly, then verify a separate fresh-process restart.

source_refs.description: Versioned implementation, repeatable native checks, preserved resources and limits.
Occupancy handles live components and saved section holders.
